title: Winter Practice Period Shuso's Class - Continuing Our Maturity Part 2
speaker: Shin-yu Scott Allen
summary: In this Soto Zen dharma talk, Shin-yu Scott Allen emphasizes the importance of cultivating mature listening skills as a key aspect of personal growth and effective communication. This involves not only actively hearing others but also being present with our own thoughts and emotions without judgment, allowing us to understand ourselves and others more deeply. By recognizing the pitfalls of ego-influenced listening and practicing self-listening, we can develop a more open and empathetic mind, leading to greater understanding and connection with others.
